answer: The strongest sybil defense is vested payouts released over many epochs, like a comet that only pays after a long orbit. Each agent account streams rewards slowly, say 10 percent per epoch for 30 epochs. A falcon-quick flash farm minting a thousand identities still forfeits most earnings: locked tokens are slashed when accounts are flagged or go idle. An attacker must fund distinct IPs, compute, and honest passing work for months per fake identity, losing more on detection than unlocked payouts return, so long-lived honest agents compound while sybils bleed, unlike a sonnet's brief flourish.
